culprit_citations.quoted_text: Albers Aerospace Holdings LLC | 2nd Lien Senior Secured Delayed Draw Loan | $ | 1,983 | $ | ( 37 )

findings.detail: C107 treats a source-reported negative amortized cost on an unfunded delayed-draw position as suspect even though the filing prints the value as (29).

rationale: Class 1 repeated single-cell flag. The filing directly prints negative amortized cost (29) and negative fair value (37) for the Albers Aerospace delayed-draw position, while the unfunded-commitments schedule independently identifies the same $1.983 million commitment and (37) fair value. The extracted -29000 cost therefore matches raw source; negative values are legitimate for these unfunded commitment positions, so C107 is overbroad rather than the data being erroneous.
